slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on Creating Your Own API Key
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Creating Your Own API Key.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Navigate to the Google AI Studio website.
• Generate a new API key.
• Copy and securely store the generated API key.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
Here I am using a browser on a computer.
You will need a web browser and an active Google account.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should have Module 2: Art of the Prompt.

slides.title: Open Google AI Studio
slides.narration:
Open your web browser.
Navigate to the **Google AI Studio** website.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio interface

slides.title: Sign in with Google Account
slides.narration:
If prompted, sign in.
Use your **Google account** credentials.
You will see the **AI Studio dashboard**.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio sign-in page, then dashboard

slides.title: Navigate to API Keys
slides.narration:
Locate the **left-hand navigation panel**.
Click on **Get API Key**.
You will see the **API key management section**.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google AI Studio left-hand navigation panel with 'Get API Key' highlighted

slides.title: Create New API Key
slides.narration:
Click the **Create API key in new project** button.
A new **API key** is generated.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google AI Studio API key management section, 'Create API key in new project' button highlighted

slides.title: Copy the API Key
slides.narration:
Locate the new **API key**.
Click the **Copy** icon next to it.
The **API key** is copied to your clipboard.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: newly generated API key with 'Copy' icon highlighted

slides.title: Store Key Securely
slides.narration:
Paste your copied **API key**.
Store it in a secure location.
Use an environment variable or a password manager.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, securely storing API key in a password manager or environment variable

slides.title: Verify API Key Listing
slides.narration:
Verify the **API keys dashboard**.
The newly created **API key** is listed.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google AI Studio API keys dashboard showing the newly created API key listed

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we did.
We navigated to the **Google AI Studio** website.
We generated a new **API key**.
We copied and stored the **API key** securely.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
First, try creating another API key from your Google AI Studio account.
Then, delete it.
Compare the results.
